# FigureOut

> FigureOut is a digital engineering studio specializing in web applications, AI product integration, and UI/UX design.

## Overview
- **Brand Name**: FigureOut
- **Alternate Names**: Figure Out, Figure Out Agency, FigureOut Studio, Figure Out Digital
- **Founder**: Ali Raza Awan
- **Website**: https://figureout.surge.sh
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/ALI-RAZA-AWAN/Figure-Out

## Core Expertise & Services
1. **Web & Full-Stack Application Development**: High-speed web applications built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
2. **AI Product Integration**: Integration of LLMs, AI automation workflows, and custom intelligent features.
3. **UI/UX Design & Brand Systems**: Design systems, interactive prototypes, and user-centric digital interfaces.

## Featured Applications
- **Aurora**: Web application dashboard.
- **Sehat Clinic**: Digital healthcare management platform.
- **Zamin**: Real estate platform.
- **Markaz Travel**: Travel & booking agency platform.
- **Pulse**: Analytics and monitoring dashboard.
